messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — final freeze starts in 30m. Posting the last-mile safety sweep and checklist. Please ack only the items you own.

sam: Ack. I'll run the canary for `2026.03.20-rc2` and monitor traffic shift.

priya: Ack from infra. DB migration dry-run completed on staging. Runbook link: https://docs.internal/redwood/migrations/2026-03-20

axel: Oncall ack. Rollback plan: pin back to `2026.03.19-stable` and disable new routes. Circuit-breaker threshold: error-rate >= 5% sustained for 2mins.

jordan: Need a last-minute exemption for an embeddings tweak (low-risk param change). I'll drop a PR and tag @maria — if no reply by T-15m treat as no-exempt.

maria: Copy. Exemption window closes T-15m. If you request exemption include: impact summary, smoke commands, and a fallback.

sam: Canary plan (short):
```
/deploy start --model=rc2 --stage=canary --traffic=10% --duration=10m
# monitor: /dash/canary-rc2
```
I'll push to 10% -> 50% -> 100% if metrics stay green.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by sam: `start canary rc2` — ETA 20m. Will post progress updates here.

priya: Smoke tests to run post-canary (quick list):
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood-inference/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq '.text'
# check kv-cache hit ratio in infra-stats
# run p95/p99 latency script: scripts/latency/check_p95.sh
```

sam: Metrics knobs: if p95 > 500ms for 2 consecutive 1-min windows OR error-rate > 3% for 3 mins we pause and rollback. I'll annotate thresholds in the dashboard.

axel: Logging note: increase sampling to 100% for the canary group for first 10m. Helps triage.

release-council: Release notes published: https://changelog.redwood/2026-03-20-rc2 (summary + known issues).

maria: Final sign-offs please — post a one-word ack if you own an item (infra/canary/rollback/docs). :white_check_mark:

axel: infra ack :thumbsup:

sam: canary ack :rocket:

priya: docs/runbooks ack — migrations doc updated.

jordan: exemption PR posted: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/728 — tagging @maria for review.

maria: Reviewing PR now. If merged we allow the tweak to ship in canary only. Otherwise we hold.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1718501300 for `2026.03.20-rc2` — traffic 10%. Monitoring hooks live.

sam: Seeing normal latency so far. Dash shows p95=210ms, error-rate=0.2%.

maria: Thanks team. I'll stay pinned here during the window. If anything spikes, call me and post #incident if we need an escalation channel.

deploy-bot: Canary health update @ 1718501360: p95=220ms, errors=0.3%, kv-cache hit 72%. Continuing to 50% in 6m unless flagged.

axel: Oncall monitoring — no alerts.

maria: Good. Moving to 50% in 5. If no objections, I'll flip the next step.

sam: go for it.

maria: Rolling to 50% now. Will post final completion when we hit 100%. :white_check_mark:
